purpose.en: Extend your upper back and open your shoulders.

text.zh: 髋在膝盖正上方，胸口在两臂之间下沉
text.en: Keep your hips over your knees and sink your chest between your arms

text.zh: 双手平放椅面，手臂伸直
text.en: Place your hands flat on the seat with straight arms.

text.zh: 腰不塌，保持呼吸后抬回
text.en: Keep your lower back from sagging, breathe, then lift back.

commonErrors.en: Sagging the lower back instead of extending the upper back.

cautions.zh: 只拉到舒适的程度，出现疼痛就放松
cautions.en: Stretch only to a comfortable point, and ease off if anything hurts.

cautions.zh: 使用稳固、不带轮子的椅子
cautions.en: Use a sturdy chair without wheels.
